criteria.written: 2026-11-13, before job full2 was staged; thresholds from field semantics (FP32 storage ~6e-8, FP32 terms ~1e-7, cross-executor FP32 activation divergence), not fitted to full2
criteria.normalization: normalized error = |a-b|/s, s fixed by field meaning: positive magnitudes |a|; dots their Cauchy-Schwarz bound; margin fields the row's sum |terms|; logZ/entropy max(|a|,1); probabilities 1
criteria.G1: ids and every logit bank (first and final step, every arm) bitwise equal on vs off and onnr vs off
criteria.determinism: F1/on vs G1/on rows (all prefill and decode rows) and on vs onnr rows bitwise equal

G2.what: lean vs fast teacher-forced: different executors, so fields inherit FP32 activation divergence

G3_lean.what: lean ledger vs float64 recomputation from the same run's ports (ledger arithmetic only)

criteria.G3_top12: ledger top1/top2 equal the float64 top-1/top-2 ids from dumped states x readout, except where the float64 gap (top1-top2 for top1, top2-top3 for top2) < top12_tie_logit
